visual.general_description: Annotated frontal chest radiograph with yellow arrows marking hyperinflation, flattened diaphragm domes and cardiac width.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale frontal chest radiograph filling the frame, showing both lungs, ribs, clavicles, mediastinum and both hemidiaphragms. A white "R" side marker is at the upper left of the image with a small adjacent character that is not clearly legible; no other patient identifiers, dates or measurements are visible. Yellow overlay annotations of three kinds: two solid single-headed arrows in the right and left lower lung zones pointing toward the lower lateral lung fields; two dotted single-headed arrows pointing upward at the right and left hemidiaphragm domes; one dashed double-headed horizontal arrow across the mediastinum at the lower cardiac level spanning the width of the cardiac silhouette. Both lung fields appear large and dark (lucent) with the diaphragm contours low and appearing flat, and the cardiac silhouette appears narrow and elongated. These are descriptive appearances consistent with the caption arrows, not independent measurements; no cardiothoracic ratio value is printed.

visual.general_description: Schematic of a home-to-hospital telerehabilitation system with video tablet, monitored parameters and clinical staff.
visual.detailed_description: Black-and-white schematic on a white background with a cloud icon at top centre containing a circled downward arrow and a circled upward arrow (data download/upload); no lines connect the cloud to the two buildings. Left: a house outline containing a seated silhouetted person on a chair with feet on a small portable pedal/cycle device on the floor, a tablet showing a video call (a large head-and-shoulders silhouette in a white garment with a small inset of the seated person and pause/play icons), and a Wi-Fi router plugged into a wall outlet with a Wi-Fi symbol. Beside the house the label reads "<Monitoring>" with bulleted items BP, PR, SpO2 and "mMRC dyspnea scale". Right: a building with a hospital cross sign containing a desktop monitor showing a video of the seated person with a small inset of a head-and-shoulders figure, a keyboard and mouse, a white-coated staff figure seen from behind, and a physician silhouette with a stethoscope. Dotted arrows: a long dotted line along the bottom with an arrowhead pointing up into each building and a mobile-phone icon near its centre; a mobile-phone icon at the right with a dotted arrow up to the physician and another dotted arrow left to the white-coated staff figure. No patient identifiers, measured values, scale or timing are shown; BP, PR and SpO2 appear as labels only.
